title: test(plugin-security): pin explain controlled_by_parent update/delete verdict under a Modify All Data master beside the door
body:
Fixes #22721
Clause-②: no

## What this is

Stage 1 of #22721: the measurement the triage direction (comment 6101562558) asks for, plus one test file that pins the one route the measurement found unpinned. No source file changes.

**The card's defect does not reproduce on `main`.** On a booted stack at `origin/main` `d7b26df5`, which contains #22529 (`d303b3e7af`) and #22549 (`86bf9ed7d5`), `git merge-base --is-ancestor` exit 0 for both, the record-grained `security/explain` answers `record.visible: true` for both `update` and `delete` of a `controlled_by_parent` child whose master another user owns and the caller may edit. The data door answers 200 for the same caller and row, through each of the three routes measured. A caller who may not edit the master is refused by both. The console header (objectui `origin/main` `5330afd`, `packages/plugin-detail/src/useRecordEditable.ts`) posts exactly `{object, operation, recordId}` for `update` and `delete` and reads `decision.record.visible`, so on `main` it offers Edit and Delete to the HotCRM sales manager. The card was measured on 17.7.0, which predates both corrections; hosted tenants receive them with cloud's v18 pin.

## The measurement, through the real HTTP doors

Booted with `@objectstack/verify` `bootStack`: better-auth sign-ups, the REST explain route, the generic `/data` door, plugin-sharing and plugin-security. The boot is `orgContext: true`, so the ownership floor (`owner_only_writes` / `owner_only_deletes`, positions `org_member`) binds every caller. This was a scratch probe, untracked and deleted after the reading.

- **Master** `hmx_account`: `sharingModel: 'private'`, owned and created by another member (`rep`).
- **Details** `hmx_contract`, `hmx_quote`, `hmx_note`: all `controlled_by_parent` under it. Every child was inserted as the system, so no caller created any of them.
  - `hmx_contract` has HotCRM's `crm_contract` grant shape: edit, no delete, no write bypass.
  - `hmx_quote` has HotCRM's `crm_quote` grant shape: CRUD, with `modifyAllRecords` on the detail too.
  - `hmx_note` has plain CRUD and no bypass, so a delete reaches the master check alone.
- **Grants:** each caller's set is distributed through a position's `permissionSets` (the `main` spelling since `bfc15d27`). Each caller's resolved positions and sets were asserted before anything was measured.

| route | caller | how the caller may edit the master | HotCRM analogue (hotcrm `1d7148bf`) |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | `mgr` | `viewAllRecords` + `modifyAllRecords` on the master | the `sales_manager` profile on `crm_account` (`src/sales/profiles/sales-manager.profile.ts`) |
| B | `team` | a criteria sharing rule on the master, `accessLevel: 'edit'`, recipient a position the caller holds | `account_team_sharing` (`src/sales/sharing/account.sharing.ts`) |
| C | `unitmgr` | a business-unit subtree sharing rule (`unit_and_subordinates`, edit); the caller is in the parent unit of the owner's unit | none. This is the open edition's "manager over the owner"; hierarchy write depth needs `hierarchy-security` (enterprise), and `defineStack` refuses it here |
| X | `control` | object-level edit on master and details, and no route to the master row | none |

The master's own `PATCH` answered 200 for A, B and C, and 404 for X.

Each cell below shows explain's `record.visible` (with `decidedBy` where it is a refusal), then the door's status. Explain was `POST /api/v1/security/explain {object, operation, recordId}`, 200 on every cell. The door was `PATCH` or `DELETE /api/v1/data/OBJECT/ID`.

| caller, master | contract update | contract delete | quote update | quote delete | note update | note delete |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A, a master rule B matches | true · 200 | false, object_crud · 403 | true · 200 | true · 200 | true · 200 | true · 200 |
| A, a master rule B does not match | true · 200 | false, object_crud · 403 | true · 200 | true · 200 | true · 200 | true · 200 |
| B, a master the rule matches | true · 200 | false, object_crud · 403 | true · 200 | true · 200 | true · 200 | true · 200 |
| B, a master the rule does not match (control) | false, no decider · 404 | false, object_crud · 403 | false, no decider · 404 | false, no decider · 404 | false, no decider · 404 | false, no decider · 404 |
| C | true · 200 | false, object_crud · 403 | true · 200 | true · 200 | true · 200 | true · 200 |
| X (control) | false, no decider · 404 | false, object_crud · 403 | false, no decider · 404 | false, no decider · 404 | false, no decider · 404 | false, no decider · 404 |

Explain's verdict equals the door's on all 36 cells.
- **Contract delete** is refused by both faces at the object gate, as HotCRM intends (`allowDelete: false` on `crm_contract`).
- **The two controls** cannot read the master, so the child is unreadable. The door answers 404 (Ruling A on the write doors), and explain answers the matching missing-record shape: `visible: false` with no decider.

## What was already pinned, and why one new file

**Already pinned, explain beside the door, on `controlled_by_parent`:**
- `controlled-by-parent-write-member.test.ts` covers update, delete and transfer for four masters: an owned master, a master shared at `edit` to the caller (`c_shared`), an RLS-admitted master and a two-hop chain.
- Its REST twin, `packages/qa/dogfood/test/cbp-explain-master-write.dogfood.test.ts`, covers the owned master.
- Route B reduces to the `c_shared` shape at evaluation. The probe read the rule's grants as three `sys_record_share` rows with `recipient_type: 'user'` and `access_level: 'edit'`.

**Not pinned anywhere for explain:** route A, `modifyAllRecords` on the master alone, which is HotCRM's actual route. `controlled-by-parent-detail-write-authority.test.ts` pins the door with the bypass on both objects and never asks explain. The master check reaches the bypass through two seams of its own:
- the master's ownership floor comes off on the sharing write verdict `allow`;
- the record-sharing leg is the bypass branch of `canEdit`.

**New:** `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/explain-controlled-by-parent-master-modify-all.test.ts`. The rig is the real `SecurityPlugin`, `ObjectQL` over better-sqlite3, the real `SharingService` and its middleware, and the platform's `member_default` floor armed (`org_member`) for both callers.
- **Armed:** every row was created by another user. For each caller, explain's `rls` record on a row neither caller created names the floor's predicate, `{ created_by: CALLER }`.
- **Update and delete by the bypass holder:** explain answers `visible: true`, and the door admits.
- **Control** (`viewAllRecords` on the master, without `modifyAllRecords`): the door answers `PERMISSION_DENIED` / 403 with "requires edit access to its master record". Explain answers `{ visible: false, decidedBy: 'sharing' }`, and its sharing detail names the master check's leg.
- **Reference:** the master's own door admits the holder and refuses the viewer.

## Ablation of the negative pin

The mutation went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in WRAP mode, in `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/explain-engine.ts`. It changes `const masterOrFault = MASTER_CHECKED_BY_ID_WRITES.has(engineOp) && recordExists && deps.checkControlledByParentWrite` to `const masterOrFault = false && MASTER_CHECKED_BY_ID_WRITES.has(engineOp) && ...`, so explain stops asking the master check. That is the pre-#22529 shape.
- **Landed:** anchor count 1 to 0, blob `1d8f2ff1` to `ee54fcff`.
- **Run:** 2 failed, 4 passed. The failures are exactly the two control cells. Their door assertion (403) held, and explain answered:

```text
- "decidedBy": "sharing",
+ "decidedBy": "object_crud",
  "recordId": "c_viewer_update",
- "visible": false,
+ "visible": true,
```

(`delete` reads the same.)
- **Restored:** the blob after restore is `1d8f2ff1`, equal to HEAD; `git diff HEAD` is empty and `git status --porcelain` is clean. The mutation was never staged or committed.
- **Run twice:** at `7dc3c671` and again at `da157165` (after the merge below), with the same reading both times. `explain-engine.ts` and the test are byte-identical across the merge.

## Tests and gates, at HEAD `da157165`

The branch merges `origin/main` `149294c02`. Two commits there touch `plugin-security` and `plugin-sharing` (#22671, #22745); the delta against `main` is still exactly the one new file (+275). After `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, the `@objectstack/plugin-security...` closure was rebuilt (18 tasks).

- **The new file:** 6 passed.
- **The full `@objectstack/plugin-security` suite (`vitest run --maxWorkers=2`):** 200 files passed, 4145 tests passed and 45 skipped. The lock reported VERDICT command-exit 0. Before the merge, at `7dc3c671`, it read 199 files, 4132 passed and 45 skipped.
- **`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security typecheck`:** exit 0. The test-layer program (`tsconfig.test.json`, `--listFilesOnly`) lists the new file, with 0 errors and 0 debt.
- **Derived gates** (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`): 57 derived, all exit 0. Each exit code was recorded before any pipe. The `--ran` reconciliation reads: 57 derived, 57 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (derived from the recorded codes), 0 UNRUN.
  - In the first battery, at `7dc3c671`, three gates exited 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET.
  - `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` lacked its pinned fixture commit on this shallow clone. It exits 0 after `git fetch --depth=1` of `621a4876`.
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n` lacked other packages' `dist/`, which that battery's `check:type-check-debt` then built. Both were rerun at `da157165` on post-merge builds. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` reports 107 require entry points across 66 packages load. `check:i18n` reports 9 packages, all bundles in sync.
- **Lint, narrowed to the one touched file:** `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` reads 1 file, 0 errors and 0 warnings. eslint's own resolved config for the file (`--print-config`) is a linted config, and it carries no `parserOptions.project` and no `projectService`. With no type-aware linting, a new test file cannot move any other file's verdict, and the merge did not change `eslint.config.mjs`. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- **Changeset:** none, and `skip-changeset` applies. `files[]` is `dist`, `README.md` and `CHANGELOG.md`. After a rebuild of `plugin-security`, `dist/` carries 0 hits for the test's symbols, against 4 files each for two positive controls.

## Acceptance notes

- **Out-of-scope finding, reported to the seat:** for the two unreadable-child controls, explain's `sharing` layer detail says "The update answers 403 PERMISSION_DENIED" (and likewise for delete), while the door answers 404 `RECORD_NOT_FOUND`. The top-level record verdict is the correct missing-record shape; only the layer prose names a status the door does not give. The read-absent rewrite in `explainAccess` replaces `record` and leaves layer prose as computed. Nothing here touches it.
- **The fixture's position binding:** the fixture binds sets through a position's `permissionSets`, which is `main`'s ADR-0131 spelling. HotCRM on 17.7.0 binds its `sales_manager` set by naming it after the position. The route under test, the master check's answer for a bypass holder on the master, does not depend on which spelling delivered the set.
